messages:
Eve (sales): Hey team — new POC with RegioBank (EU bank). They sent a vendor-risk checklist and want three artifacts before kickoff: 1) simplified dataflow diagram (ingress -> inference -> logs) showing EU-only boundaries, 2) definitive subprocessor list (names + roles + region), 3) KMS/key custody statement. POC kickoff Thurs. Can we get deliverables by Wed EOD? @Liam @Priya

Liam (solutions): We can do the diagram + subproc CSV. Clarify hosting constraint: they said 'no cross-border storage' — so we should propose Private (VPC) or Dedicated with EU-only storage. Is on-prem on the table? @Maya for contract constraints

Priya (security): Security notes: confirm log retention periods and whether they require pseudonymization at rest. We can supply SOC2 scoping & CAIQ subset. KMS: customer-managed keys (BYOK) supported in Private deployment; Hosted API uses provider-managed keys (not acceptable for strict residency).

Maya (legal): For subprocessors we can provide an exported snapshot (active vendors only) + standard contractual clause references. Do NOT promise future vendors. I can prepare an attestation letter about data locality for signature.

Liam (solutions): Draft sketch of dataflow nodes (one-liner):
Client -> TLS -> Ingress LB (eu) -> Auth (OIDC) -> Inference (dedicated-gpu-eu) -> KV cache (redis-eu) -> Logs (s3-eu, encrypted) -> Monitoring (eu).

Liam (solutions): Quick CSV sample we'll hand off: 
name,role,location,contracted
FastCloud,hosting,eu-west-1,yes
KeySafe,KMS,eu-central-1,yes
RedisCorp,cache,eu-west-1,yes
StorageCo,logging,eu-west-1,yes

Eve (sales): Good. Also need a rough price addon for a short-term Dedicated commit for POC (2x A100 equiv) so they can sign off on cost. @Sam can you provide a ballpark?

Sam (product): Ballpark: ~€12k/month for reserved 2x-A100 equivalent (includes burst & networking). If they require on-prem private packaging there will be an additional eng services estimate. I'll prepare a simple quote sheet.

deploy-bot: INF ticket created: INF-4231 — provision POC Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 (ETA 48h).

Priya (security): One potential blocker flagged by their VR team: they requested full CAIQ v4. We typically return a completed CAIQ subset focusing on hosting & runtime controls and call out items that rely on cloud provider controls. I'll start the CAIQ draft and note any gaps.

Maya (legal): I'll generate the attestation + contract clause snippet. Sales: when you have the RegioBank contact for signature, route to me and I'll add the signatory block.

Liam (solutions): Uploaded initial dataflow + subproc CSV draft to Drive (private): https://drive.example/regiobank-poc (will update with final SVG + PNG).

Eve (sales): Timeline recap: Wed EOD — final dataflow diagram + subprocessor CSV + KMS note + ballpark quote. Thu — POC kickoff. If anything slips, ping here. Thanks :thumbsup:

Sam (product): I'll drop the quote PDF before EOD and flag the service-level notes for Dedicated vs Private.

Priya (security): I'll attach the CAIQ sections we can complete asap. Flagging retention policy question for RegioBank: need exact retention window to finalize logs control section.

Eve (sales): Noted, I'll ask RegioBank on retention and on-prem appetite. Will update once they reply.

Liam (solutions): Will publish final diagram + CSV to the drive and ping legal for attestation.

Maya (legal): Ready to review when posted.

Eve (sales): Great — closing the loop here.
